spawn.storyDescription:
Update service integration tests are located under 'src/UpdateResourceProvider/UpdateService/IntegrationTest', current implementation have the following limitations:

- redundant code
- many wait and flaky 
- difficult to setup pre-conditions

Based on attached files, try to refactor and make it clean, easy to adopt and easy to understand
